prep.title: Interview prep
prep.sub: Practice for a real interview, built from the job you applied to.
prep.fullMockD: Round 1, then Round 2. Pass the recorded round to unlock the live one.
prep.tile1D: Five timed questions on camera, recorded and scored.
prep.tile2D: Fifteen minutes with a live interviewer.
tavus.hint: Create a key at platform.tavus.io (it has a free tier). The key stays on this computer.
prep.needRole: Type the role you're interviewing for.
prep.needJd: Paste the job description so we can build the interview.
prep.rolePh: Role you're interviewing for, e.g. Data Analyst
prep.cvHint: PDF, DOCX, or an image. Optional, it sharpens the questions.
r2.tileNoKey: Needs a pass or a free Tavus key
r1.disclaimer: Practice for a HireVue-style one-way video interview. Not affiliated with HireVue, Inc.
r1.notice1: Your recordings stay on this computer. Nothing is uploaded.
r1.notice2: You can delete them from the report at any time.
r1.notice3: There is no facial analysis. Only what you say is scored.
r1.extraTimeD: Doubles the prep and answer clocks on every question.
r1.noCamera: This browser can't reach your camera. Try Chrome or Edge.
r1.allowCamera: Camera and mic access is needed. Please allow them and try again.
r1.connOff: Connection: you appear to be offline
r1.devicesSub: Make sure you can see yourself and the bar moves when you talk.
r1.tip1: Have the light in front of you, not behind.
r1.tip2: Find a spot free from distractions and noise.
r1.tip3: Don't worry about eye contact, just be natural.
r1.qHelp: Use the prep time to think. Recording starts when it ends, or sooner if you choose.
r1.answerHelp: Answer in your own words. Stop when you're done, or the clock will stop for you.
r1.practiceDone: That was practice. Nothing was saved.
r1.noRetakes: No retakes left on this question; your earlier take stands.
r1.doneSub: Saving and scoring your answers on this computer. This takes a minute.
r1.typeSub: This computer couldn't transcribe some answers. Type what you said so they can be scored.
r1.typeAll: Add the words for every answer first.
r1.transcriptSum: Your answer, with filler and hedging highlighted
r1.reportDisclaimer: Practice feedback, not a hiring decision.
r1.deleteConfirm: Delete this interview and its recordings? This can't be undone.
r1.unlockedD: A live interview with the Tavus interviewer, 15 minutes.
r1.hedgeTip: Interviewers hear hedging as uncertainty. State it directly.
r1.weTip: You said 'we' a lot. Name what YOU did.
r1.coachWorking: Building a stronger version from your profile...
r1.coachFailed: Couldn't strengthen this answer right now.
r1.coachNote: Built from your real profile. Use it as a model, then say it in your own words.
r2.title: Round 2, live interview
r2.step1: Create an account at platform.tavus.io. It has a free tier; check its minutes and call length there.
r2.step2: Create an API key there and copy it.
r2.step3: Paste it in Settings, under Live interviewer (Tavus).
r2.gateNoMinutes: Your Tavus minutes for this month are used up. They reset monthly.
r2.gateNoKey: The live interviewer runs on Tavus with your own free key.
r2.previewOff: Your camera preview will appear here
r2.greenSub: 15 minutes with a live interviewer. They ask, you answer, and they follow up like a real interview.
r2.skippedR1: Straight to Round 2, no Round 1 first.
r2.note: Your camera and mic stay on this computer.
r2.notPassed: Pass Round 1 first to unlock Round 2.
r2.speak: Speak naturally. They will ask and follow up just like a real interview.
r2.openedTab: Your live interview opened in a new tab.
tavus.stateSet: Your key is saved on this computer. Round 2 uses your own Tavus minutes.
tavus.stateUnset: Round 2 talks to a live interviewer on Tavus. It needs your own key.
r2.usedUpH: You've used your pass's live interviews.
r2.usedUpD: Buy more, they never expire. Or use your own Tavus key.
r2.usedUpNoBuy: Add another pass, or use your own Tavus key.
r2.buyOpened: Finish paying in the checkout, then check again.
r2.notYet: Not there yet. It can take a moment after paying.
